# Stakeholders: rights, powers and protection {#sec-blp-stakeholders}

> *Assessment objective 3: the interests, rights, obligations and powers of stakeholders in a
> business.*

::: {.callout-note title="Not yet written"}
Outline below.
:::

## Planned contents

**Shareholders** — the rights attaching to shares; class rights and their variation; the division of
power between board and general meeting; what a shareholders' agreement adds that the articles
cannot.

**Minority protection** — unfair prejudice petitions under s.994 CA 2006, the remedies available and
the buy-out order in practice; derivative claims under ss.260–264 and the two-stage permission
filter; just and equitable winding up.

**Directors as stakeholders** — service contracts, remuneration, and the tension between the s.172
duty and the interests of a controlling shareholder.

**Creditors** — when the directors' duty shifts to take creditors' interests into account, and what
that shift actually requires.

**Partners and LLP members** — rights to management, information and profit share; expulsion; the
consequences of the PA 1890 defaults where an agreement is silent.

**Conduct** — acting for a company when instructed by a majority shareholder whose interests diverge
from the company's.
